MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    
    visited = [False] * p
    result = 1
    
    if k == 1:
        result = p
    else:
        for i in range(1, p):
            if not visited[i]:
                cur = i
                while not visited[cur]:
                    visited[cur] = True
                    cur = (cur * k) % p
                result = (result * p) % MOD
    
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
